summary.text: Jack Jordan is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 17, has served since 2016, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jack Jordan grew up on a small farm in the Bremen, Indiana, area and graduated from Bremen High School in 1979.

He completed a one-year industrial management program at Purdue University, earned a B.S. from Liberty University and an MBA from Purdue's Krannert Graduate School of Management, and in 2005 earned a certificate in executive business management from the Mendoza College of Business.

His career experience includes working as a business consultant for the pharmaceutical industry and start-ups, serving as a partner in a home construction and renovation company, and sitting on the board of directors of Bremen Castings, Inc.
Jordan assumed office in the Indiana House on November 9, 2016, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Democrat Mary Gibson.
For 2025-2026, he was assigned to the Family, Children and Human Affairs, Government and Regulatory Reform, and Ways and Means committees.
